part.name: Combination wrench with open jaw and ring end

part_functions.name: Fastener operation
part_functions.function: Transfers hand-applied torque to nuts or bolt heads through either the open jaw or the closed ring interface.

part_functions.name: Dual-access wrenching
part_functions.function: Provides an open end for lateral engagement and a ring end for enclosed engagement and improved fastener retention.

part_functions.name: Manual load transmission
part_functions.function: The elongated solid body acts as a lever and transmits bending and torsional loads between the user's hand and either wrench head.

sections.name: Open-jaw head at the semantic front (-Z end)

section_functions.name: Lateral fastener engagement
section_functions.function: Two opposed jaw arms surround three sides of a fastener while the open front permits engagement without axial access.

section_functions.name: Jaw load distribution
section_functions.function: Broad curved outer arms support the inner wrenching slot and transfer opposing contact forces into the handle; the arms are approximately bilateral about the X=0 center plane.

features.name: Left open-jaw arm and handle transition

feature_functions.name: Left jaw support
feature_functions.function: Forms the left outer jaw boundary and blends into the left handle edge to carry contact-induced bending load toward the handle.

feature_functions.name: Symmetric jaw relationship
feature_functions.function: Works opposite the right jaw arm to constrain a fastener across the open slot.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Small radius left-side blend connecting the straight handle edge to the enlarged open-jaw head.
Large convex cylindrical outer surface of the left jaw arm, extending from the handle transition to the open tip.

features.name: Right open-jaw arm and handle transition

feature_functions.name: Right jaw support
feature_functions.function: Forms the right outer jaw boundary and blends into the right handle edge to carry contact-induced bending load toward the handle.

feature_functions.name: Opposed gripping member
feature_functions.function: Opposes the left jaw arm so torque can be transmitted through separated contact regions on the fastener.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Small radius right-side blend connecting the straight handle edge to the enlarged open-jaw head.
Large convex cylindrical outer surface of the right jaw arm, extending from the handle transition to the open tip.

feature_functions.name: Fastener interface
feature_functions.function: The two straight opposed walls establish the wrench opening, while the radiused inner corners and flat root provide clearance and reduce stress concentration.

feature_functions.name: Jaw-arm integration
feature_functions.function: The slot boundaries are structurally adjacent to the two jaw arms and terminate in a rounded closed root that transfers load between them.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left straight inner wall of the open slot, running from the mouth toward the rounded slot root.
Left concave corner radius joining the left slot wall to the flat inner root.
Flat transverse root surface closing the inner end of the open wrench slot.
Right concave corner radius joining the flat inner root to the right slot wall.
Right straight inner wall of the open slot, running from the rounded root to the mouth.

sections.name: Central elongated handle and recessed top panel

section_functions.name: Lever arm
section_functions.function: The long rectangular spine separates the two working heads and magnifies hand-applied torque while carrying axial, bending, and torsional loads.

section_functions.name: Head integration
section_functions.function: The continuous top and bottom skins structurally unite the open head, handle, and ring head into one monolithic solid.

section_functions.name: Surface relief
section_functions.function: A shallow rounded rectangular recess distinguishes the top side and removes a small amount of material while leaving a continuous perimeter frame.

features.name: Monolithic handle spine and broad skins

feature_functions.name: Torque transmission
feature_functions.function: Straight longitudinal sidewalls and broad top and bottom faces create a stiff beam connecting both wrench heads.

feature_functions.name: Continuous structural support
feature_functions.function: The broad skins are adjacent to the outer head contours, ring annulus, handle edges, and recess boundary, tying all functional interfaces together.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Long left longitudinal edge face of the handle between the ring-end blend and open-head blend.
Continuous top planar skin at Y=15 spanning the handle and both heads, with boundaries for the ring bore and recessed panel.
Long right longitudinal edge face of the handle between the open-head blend and ring-end blend.
Continuous bottom planar skin at Y=0 spanning the complete wrench and surrounding the ring bore.

feature_functions.name: Material relief and visual indexing
feature_functions.function: The approximately 1 mm deep pocket removes minor noncritical material, provides a distinct top-side indicator, and may serve as a marking or grip-detail region.

feature_functions.name: Perimeter reinforcement relationship
feature_functions.function: The recess remains enclosed by the thicker surrounding handle frame, preserving longitudinal stiffness and edge strength.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Large flat floor of the shallow handle recess at Y=14.

sections.name: Closed ring head at the semantic back (+Z end)

section_functions.name: Enclosed fastener engagement
section_functions.function: The annular head surrounds a fastener interface to improve retention and distribute torque around the circumference.

section_functions.name: Ring-to-handle load transfer
section_functions.function: Rounded bilateral neck blends join the annular head to the straight handle, reducing abrupt section changes and transferring torque into the spine.

features.name: Annular ring body and neck transitions

feature_functions.name: Bore support
feature_functions.function: The thick outer annulus retains and supports the central bore under circumferential wrenching loads.

feature_functions.name: Handle connection
feature_functions.function: Left and right filleted transitions are adjacent to the handle sidewalls and merge their load paths into the circular ring.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left rounded transition from the straight handle edge into the outside of the ring head.
Main convex cylindrical outside perimeter of the closed ring head.
Right rounded transition from the outside of the ring head into the straight handle edge.

feature_functions.name: Closed fastener interface
feature_functions.function: The through bore receives a fastener head or nut and retains it laterally while torque is applied through the surrounding annulus.

feature_functions.name: Coaxial annular relationship
feature_functions.function: The bore passes through the full Y thickness and is concentrically enclosed by the ring body's outer cylindrical perimeter.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Full-depth cylindrical inner wall of the circular ring bore.
